name: Boiled eggs
method:
1. Cover the eggs with the water in a small pan.
2. Bring to the boil and cook for 10 minutes.
3. Drain carefully, cool and peel.

name: Scrambled eggs
method:
1. Beat the eggs in a bowl.
2. Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.
3. Add the eggs and stir until fully set.

name: Tomato omelette
method:
1. Chop the tomato and beat the eggs.
2. Heat the oil and soften the tomato.
3. Add the eggs and cook until fully set, then fold.

name: Buttered toast
method:
1. Toast the bread in a toaster or dry pan.
2. Spread with the butter and serve.

name: Cheese toast
method:
1. Toast the bread on one side in a dry pan.
2. Turn it over and place the cheese on top.
3. Cover the pan and heat gently until the cheese melts.

name: Peanut butter toast
method:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Spread the peanut butter evenly over both slices.

name: Banana toast
method:
1. Toast the bread.
2. Spread with peanut butter.
3. Slice the banana and arrange it on top.

name: Banana oats
method:
1. Put the oats and water in a small pan.
2. Simmer, stirring, until the oats soften.
3. Mash the banana and stir it through.

name: Milk porridge
method:
1. Combine the oats and milk in a pan.
2. Heat gently, stirring often, until the oats soften.
3. Serve warm.

name: Plain rice
method:
1. Bring the water to a boil.
2. Add the rice, cover and lower the heat.
3. Cook until tender and the water is absorbed, then rest off the heat.

name: Tomato rice
method:
1. Chop the onion and tomato.
2. Soften the onion in the oil, then add the tomato.
3. Stir in the uncooked rice and water.
4. Cover and simmer until the rice is tender.

name: Egg rice
method:
1. Simmer the rice in the water until tender.
2. Heat the oil in a pan and scramble the eggs until set.
3. Add the cooked rice and stir until hot throughout.

name: Boiled potatoes
method:
1. Scrub the potatoes and cut into even pieces.
2. Cover with the water in a small pan.
3. Boil until tender, then drain carefully.

name: Mashed potatoes
method:
1. Peel and cut the potatoes.
2. Boil in the water until tender and drain.
3. Mash with the butter and milk.

name: Pan fried potatoes
method:
1. Scrub the potatoes and cut into thin slices.
2. Heat the oil in a pan and add the potato slices.
3. Cover and cook gently, turning often, until tender.
4. Uncover and cook until golden.

name: Tomato and onion salad
method:
1. Wash and chop the tomato.
2. Peel and finely slice the onion.
3. Toss both with the lemon juice and serve.

name: Cucumber and tomato salad
method:
1. Wash and slice the cucumber and tomato.
2. Toss with the oil and serve.

name: Carrot ribbons
method:
1. Wash and peel the carrot.
2. Use the peeler to cut thin ribbons.
3. Toss with the oil and lemon juice.

name: Buttered pasta
method:
1. Bring the water to a boil and add the pasta.
2. Cook until tender, then drain.
3. Toss with the butter and serve.

name: Tomato pasta
method:
1. Boil the pasta in the water until tender, then drain.
2. Chop the tomato and soften it in the oil in a pan.
3. Stir the cooked pasta into the tomato and heat through.
